title: Studio environment built at runtime, no HDR file
summary: No lamps and no file: a room of emissive panels (softbox, warm key and cool rim strips, thin hot sparkle strips at values up to 9, a near-black floor flag) baked once through `PMREMGenerator.fromScene` into a half-float environment, or a 1024 × 512 canvas gradient with soft light bands through `fromEquirectangular` at environment intensity 2.2; lights a chrome (metalness 1, roughness .1) and a clearcoat `MeshPhysicalMaterial`; each variant baked on first use, generators disposed after the bake; lit and held still under reduced motion and static, CSS still without WebGL
variants: panels: emissive planes baked through PMREMGenerator.fromScene (this, default)
painted: a 1024 × 512 canvas gradient with light bands through PMREMGenerator.fromEquirectangular (this, toggle)
R3F: drei <Environment> with <Lightformer> children is the same panel bake
